independentReview: root medium scoped pass recorded; low/severe independent review pending
scope: Four actual generated worlds, one fixed requested seed 20261005, three grades, normal finite FOV/lighting/camera, bare controlled training loadout, true WASD. Static complete floor used only for QA macro-route planning. No teleport, health, fog, clock, enemy edits. Capture videos are available but this review is of the explicitly listed still images, not a continuous-play or listening verdict.

worlds.finding: 连体低母面内部不再逐片封边；外断端保留有限亮切面；上下两颈均以真实WASD到达，缺地与有材质地床可分。
worlds.limits: 低档本次亲看首接近，颈口另有采集而未逐张审；重档上颈有污染体与部分遮挡，不签黑处或全地图。

worlds.finding: 独立中尺度倒束的粗面、撕端与错位内路可辨；三档近脚亮切面和冷蓝床仍分开，侵蚀随纤方向但不取代红褐本色。
worlds.limits: 仅首接近/第一内路及可见断端；未以此签宽外路全程、完整战斗或所有束背。

worlds.finding: 弯厚唇从皮面连续转到内侧亮面，材料接触与低胶尾可读；旧平直内板问题改善，三档前脚与紫床分界明确。
worlds.limits: 壳壁局部层向绿线仍属同材料侵蚀；远壳背/黑处不在通过范围。低胶为可走低面，不能把其外观深色当洞或阻挡。

worlds.finding: 一张红皮连续转向灰亮内卷端，不再是三块各封厚边的拼板；由卷端到裸床的疏密关系与真实缺口可辨。
worlds.limits: 近侧卷端与东侧散片被照见；吞光后的西侧外壁及全部回路未审；真实追兵与受伤保留，未改生命或敌人。

history.retention: Previous raw reports/images/source identities remain unchanged. This review supersedes only the specific visible construction failures at the current source.

limitations: No claim of all faces, all routes, all seeds, complete search/extraction, balance or visual fatigue.
Actual keyboard positions and phase timing differ slightly across grades; actual capture position/facing is retained, not called pixel-identical camera.
Normal darkness and solid geometry have distinct roles; unlit areas are not judged from these frames.
